note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do (rename *, lower at line 29; rename block lines 181-191; Bookmark #15: Public transportation, lines 848-888) lowercases every column and renames P05A04A1..A9, P05A04B to pt_p05a04a1..pt_p05a04a9, pt_p05a04b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The screener P05A04 is not renamed and not in this table. The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 159-168) labels each column, 10/10, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed numbering (P05A04A rows 1-9; P05A04B). Step 3b: live items (10; resp 1-10 overall) match the questionnaire's public-transport block exactly; the dictionary description ('access to and satisfaction with public transportation services') agrees; no instrument mismatch. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.7 (checked against the rendered page image at 200 dpi); the dictionary variable labels agree character-for-character on 10/10 items, so no wording overrides. Printed typo kept: the P05A04A lead-in reads 'El sevicio de transporte público que utilizó o utiliza:' ('sevicio' for 'servicio') on the page image and in the PDF text layer; shipped as printed, not corrected (the dictionary carries no label for this lead-in). Printed line breaks (A9, B stem) joined with a single space; the wide gaps in the justified B stem on the page ('nada  satisfecho(a)', 'totalmente  satisfecho(a)') are typesetting, and the dictionary label has single spaces, as shipped. Structure (mirrors guatemala_2024_homes_publicclinic): the P05A04A lead-in is shared by A1-A9 -> section_prompt of section _1; P05A04B -> section _2, no prompt. instructions blank: the left-hand cell is the screener question P05A04 ('Durante el año 2024, ¿usted o alguien de su hogar fue o es usuario de servicio de transporte público:' with options ¿Colectivo municipal? 1 / ¿Colectivo privado? 2 / ¿No es usuario? 3), which is a question not in this table rather than framing text, so it is not shipped; it is described in the public_note because it defines who answered. Interviewer lines 'Lea las opciones.' / 'Espere la respuesta.' and the routing box 'PASE A CAPÍTULO VI' not shipped. Options as printed: A1-A9 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 NS (don't know) is kept on A1-A9 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal); A9 has no NS answers in the data but the printed option is shipped. P05A04B prints bare 1-10 bubbles plus 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' (dictionary value labels = own number; 98 'No sabe / no responde'); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Item content note: A9 (bribe request) is negatively worded, so SÍ is the unfavourable answer there. Skip pattern (verified in source): the printed routing sends BOTH '¿Colectivo privado?' (2) and '¿No es usuario?' (3) to Capítulo VI, so only municipal-bus households (P05A04=1) answered this block. In ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx P05A04 = 1/2/3 = 441/3365/3080; exactly the 441 P05A04=1 households are non-blank on all ten columns and all 6,445 others are blank on all ten. The block therefore evaluates the municipal collective service only, not private buses. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 36/36 valid item x resp cells equal (a1 1/2/3 = 303/127/11; a2 342/96/3; a3 325/112/4; a4 309/118/14; a5 330/95/16; a6 265/167/9; a7 285/143/13; a8 119/315/7; a9 1/2 = 14/427; b 1..10 = 11/7/18/13/60/34/58/99/41/89) and 10/10 NULL cells equal source blank (+98 for b): a1-a9 6445 each, b 6456 = 6445 + 11. public_note: The English in the _translated columns is an IRW machine translation of INE Guatemala's Spanish questionnaire; the block was asked only of households that used the municipal collective (public) bus in 2024 (441 of 6,886), so the 6,445 households using private collectives or no public transport have resp NULL on every item, as do 11 pt_p05a04b rows answered no sabe / no responde (code 98); for items pt_p05a04a1-a9, resp 3 is NS (don't know), kept as a response category.
